question: Is Advanced06 a defensible source-aligned gain and what blocks the complete target?
summary: Retain limited crown/jaw sheet and neck/flank connection gains as a development checkpoint. Reject any full likeness, major complete-bird gain or completed-deliverable claim. Highest priority is source-specific head macro construction, followed by flowing neck/breast and swept compact shield envelope. No final acceptance or release.
execution_status: live local pixel inspection with analytical artistic judgment

material_findings.claim: Head06 produces a limited visible sheet-construction gain over the matched baseline.
material_findings.finding: Pointed crown tips are flatter and less tubular; the jaw loses the prominent gold horn accent and reads as nested dark sheets. Retain these changes. The broad pale roof courses still read as a helmet and do not establish source likeness.
material_findings.consequence: A local construction gain could be mistaken for complete-bird improvement.
material_findings.next_test: Apply OP-01 and compare the same four views at full-bird and head scale.

material_findings.claim: Advanced06 closely matches the pinned head/crown/bill/optic construction.
material_findings.finding: The bill remains a broad smooth hanging lobe connected into a rounded roof; the orbital ring remains proud and circular with a flat evenly bright orange target pattern. Sources have a distinct angular brow/bill-root seam, substantial curved cheek plate around a recessed lens, swept smaller feathers and worked metal.
affected_paths: retained CGH04 nine section convex hooked upper bill
material_findings.consequence: Dominant identity region continues to read as a stylized prop.
material_findings.next_test: OP-01; retain pose/frame and dark/awakened era contract, but do not call optical preservation artistic acceptance.

material_findings.claim: The complete-bird neck/breast/shield silhouette fulfills the locked canon.
material_findings.finding: The narrow nearly straight plated neck lands between two rounded shoulder/breast masses. Source front neck flows into an uninterrupted descending breast envelope, and its folded wing is a compact swept teardrop with unequal elongated layers. Candidate shoulder remains a dome of regular rounded scales, with an abrupt broad thigh cuff below it. Body05 is visibly unchanged.
material_findings.consequence: Head-only changes cannot supply the complete target.

material_findings.claim: Machinery06 establishes a major source-aligned machinery and heavy-foot gain at full-bird scale.
material_findings.finding: Some neck/flank connections are easier to follow, a retainable local gain. Legs and feet remain almost indistinguishable in the actual pair: sparse straight bars/open circular hubs, narrow ankle transition and blunt short claw tips. Source machinery has joined cast cases, yokes and nested shafts, with heavier curved toe roots and longer sharp talons. Counts cannot substitute for the weak visible delta.
material_findings.consequence: Mesh additions can consume another iteration without visible gain.
material_findings.next_test: OP-03; add only source-visible silhouette/case changes around fixed anchors.

material_findings.claim: Regional worked-metal appearance and nightmare screen presence match the source.
material_findings.finding: Torso has mottled blue-green metal and edge contrast, but head/bill and toe highlights remain smooth broad gray surfaces; crown roof turns pale under both lights. Source metal has distinct dark valleys, localized bronze edges/brow, fasteners and sharper specular breakup. Candidate reads tidy and rounded even under workshop lighting.
material_findings.consequence: Further uniform darkening or texture accumulation can hide rather than solve construction gaps.
material_findings.next_test: OP-04 after OP-01/02, using unchanged light/exposure.

material_findings.claim: The full three-era/eight-view/browser deliverable is complete and accepted.
material_findings.finding: Initial freeze covers Advanced only and four matched views. Supplements are outside the freeze; this reviewer did not run browser/native/export validation. Owner acceptance is pending.
material_findings.consequence: A bounded Advanced image judgment could be misreported as portable three-era completion.
material_findings.next_test: Separately freeze and review supplements and actual browser renderer evidence; then owner artistic review.

corrective_operators.retain: Thin pointed crown ends and nested dark mandible sheets.
corrective_operators.operator: Replace the broad dome/saddle roof reading with unequal overlapping swept leaves following the July head contour. Build one clearly legible diagonal supraorbital brow plate, distinct from crown and bill root; use localized bronze rim/face where the source shows it. Create an explicit bill-root seam/step and planar side panel, with a sharp deep hooked tip instead of a smooth bulb continuous with the forehead. Broaden the curved cheek plate face around the source cheek opening so it reads as sheet metal rather than a stick; tuck the lens behind that brow/cheek rim. Keep the same head frame and pose.
corrective_operators.decisive_view: Frozen head-neck, side-profile and complete bird in both lights; source landmarks rather than invented percent scaling.

corrective_operators.operator: Replace the straight necklace-like column and abrupt collar junction with staggered elongated front courses that continue from lower cheek down into the convex breast, while keeping recessed side machinery visible. Rebuild shield rows as a compact swept teardrop: smaller short shoulder courses, progressively elongated rear/downward overlapping leaves and a tapered terminal edge. Reduce the dome/lobed impression and abrupt thigh cuff via local sheet envelope shaping, retaining hip/knee/hock/foot anchors and compact rear extent. Do not import July hanging wings.
corrective_operators.decisive_view: Locked full-bird canon against unchanged neutral/workshop cameras plus profile.

corrective_operators.operator: Replace source-visible bare straight bar spans/open donut hubs with compact nested cast cases and paired shaft/yoke groups whose endpoints visibly meet existing joints. Wrap ankle-to-toe roots with interlocking curved couplings; sharpen and deepen hooked talon silhouettes locally while preserving toe ground positions and all stance anchors. Prioritize visible case mass and connections, not hidden internals or fastener count.
corrective_operators.decisive_view: Complete-bird images first; leg/foot crop second. If the full-bird delta remains indistinguishable, narrow or change the approach.

corrective_operators.operator: On the revised head and bill, break broad smooth highlights with source-scaled directional worked-metal roughness and localized edge wear; keep dark recesses and limited warm bronze brow/cheek accents. De-emphasize the pale roof response. Give optical glass depth/partial shadow and uneven warm inner intensity rather than uniformly bright concentric graphics, preserving Maker/Mechanic darkness and restrained Advanced awakening. Compare at the existing neutral/workshop lights and exposure; do not solve by globally dimming the scene.
corrective_operators.decisive_view: Full-bird and head pixels under both existing lights; browser parity separately.

limits: Same model family and inherited source/context family as other reviewers; correlated agreement is not independent validation.
All viewed references are development inputs; no unseen/protected holdout.
Camera04 is an estimated hypothesis, not calibrated registration; exact proportion percentages cannot be inferred from these images.
Fresh judgment preceded reading prior review findings; no previous QA used to establish gain.
Approval with limits means retainable local development evidence, not automatic modeling continuation, owner artistic acceptance, runtime promotion or publication.
release_conditions: Separately review three-era/eight-view and browser evidence.
Root adjudicates material disagreement or invokes conditional disruption after concordance.
review_expiry_trigger: Any geometry/material/camera/light change or supplement promotion requires a new frozen visual review.
